name: empty-js-module
description: Trivial JavaScript module with full project hygiene (.gitignore, .eslintrc) — must produce zero error findings. Catches scanner regressions on minimal-project shape.
knownNoise: Two warnings, zero errors. (1) lint:eslint — the corpus case intentionally ships without dev dependencies, so ESLint cannot run; as of 2026-08-12 that is reported as a WARNING rather than an error, because being unable to lint is not the same as finding a defect and must never block a build. (2) deadCode — the trivial module's export has no importer inside the fixture. Ceilings are exact so any ADDITIONAL finding fails the case. Note the error ceiling was TIGHTENED from 1 to 0 in the same change: a known-good case must now produce zero errors, which is what this case's description asked for all along.
